abstract: We study a platform's incentives to remove IP-infringing products and the effects of holding the platform liable for such infringements on innovation and welfare. We first show that platform liability can lead to either higher or lower commission rates, depending on how screening affects transaction volume. We then show that liability may spur or hinder innovation, depending on the intensity of cross-group network externalities, which determines participation elasticities on each side. If platform liability lowers innovation, all market participants—the platform, innovators, imitators, and buyers—are worse off. We also provide a sufficient condition for platform liability to raise welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们研究平台移除知识产权侵权产品的激励，以及平台对此类侵权承担责任对创新和福利的影响。我们首先表明，平台责任可能导致佣金率上升或下降，这取决于筛选如何影响交易量。接着，我们证明责任可能促进或阻碍创新，这取决于跨群体网络外部性的强度，该强度决定了各方的参与弹性。如果平台责任降低了创新，所有市场参与者——平台、创新者、模仿者和买家——都将受损。我们还提供了平台责任提升福利的一个充分条件。
title: Platform Liability and Innovation

abstract: We study the role of correlation in matching markets, where multiple decision makers simultaneously face selection problems from the same pool of candidates. We propose a model in which a candidate’s priority scores across different decision makers exhibit varying levels of correlation dependent on the candidate’s sociodemographic group. Such differential correlation can arise in school choice because of the varying prevalence of selection criteria, in college admissions because of test-optional policies, or because of algorithmic monoculture, that is, when decision makers rely on the same algorithms and data sets to evaluate candidates. We show that higher correlation for one of the groups generally improves the outcome for all groups, leading to higher efficiency. However, students from a given group are more likely to remain unmatched as their own correlation level increases. This implies that it is advantageous to belong to a low-correlation group. Finally, we extend the tie-breaking literature to multiple priority classes and intermediate levels of correlation. Overall, our results point to differential correlation as a previously overlooked systemic source of group inequalities in school, university, and job admissions. This paper was accepted by Itai Ashlagi, revenue management and market analytics. Funding: This work was partially supported by MIAI @ Grenoble Alpes [Grants ANR-19-P3IA-0003 and ANR-23-PEIA-0003], by the French National Research Agency (ANR) [Grants ANR-19-CE48-0018 and ANR-20-CE23-0007], and by the National Science Foundation [Grant DMS-1928930] and by the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation [Grant G-2021-16778], which funded B. Pradelski’s residency at the Simons Laufer Mathematical Sciences Institute (formerly MSRI) in Berkeley, CA, during the Fall 2023 semester. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06067 .
abstract_zh: 我们研究匹配市场中的相关性问题，其中多个决策者同时面对来自同一候选池的选择问题。我们提出一个模型，其中候选人在不同决策者之间的优先级得分呈现出不同程度的相关性，且这种相关性取决于候选人的社会人口群体。这种差异性相关可能出现在学校选择中，因为选拔标准的普遍程度不同；也可能出现在大学招生中，因为实行考试可选政策；还可能源于算法单一化，即决策者依赖相同的算法和数据集来评估候选人。我们表明，其中一个群体更高的相关性通常会改善所有群体的结果，从而提高效率。然而，来自某一给定群体的学生随着其自身相关性水平的提高，更有可能保持未匹配状态。这意味着属于低相关性群体是有利的。最后，我们将平局打破文献扩展到多个优先级类别和中间相关性水平。总体而言，我们的结果指出，差异性相关是学校、大学和工作录取中一个此前被忽视的群体不平等的系统性来源。本文由Itai Ashlagi、收益管理与市场分析领域接受。资助：本工作部分得到MIAI @ Grenoble Alpes [资助号ANR-19-P3IA-0003和ANR-23-PEIA-0003]、法国国家研究署（ANR）[资助号ANR-19-CE48-0018和ANR-20-CE23-0007]、美国国家科学基金会[资助号DMS-1928930]以及Alfred P. Sloan基金会[资助号G-2021-16778]的支持，后者资助了B. Pradelski于2023年秋季学期在加利福尼亚州伯克利的Simons Laufer数学科学研究所（原MSRI）的驻留。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06067获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Correlation of Rankings in Matching Markets
title_zh: 匹配市场中的排名相关性

abstract: Statistical arbitrage exploits temporal price differences between similar assets. We develop a comprehensive conceptual framework for statistical arbitrage and a novel data-driven solution. First, we construct arbitrage portfolios of similar assets as residual portfolios from conditional latent asset pricing factors. Second, we extract their time-series signals with a powerful machine learning time-series solution, a convolutional transformer. Lastly, we use these signals to form an optimal trading policy, which maximizes risk-adjusted returns under constraints. Our comprehensive empirical study on daily U.S. equities shows a high compensation for arbitrageurs to enforce the law of one price. Our arbitrage strategies obtain considerable out-of-sample mean returns and Sharpe ratios, and outperform all benchmark approaches. This paper was accepted by Agostino Capponi, finance. Funding: The authors thank MSCI for generous research support.
abstract_zh: 统计套利利用相似资产之间的时间性价格差异。我们为统计套利开发了一个全面的概念框架和一种新颖的数据驱动解决方案。首先，我们将相似资产的套利投资组合构建为条件潜在资产定价因子的残差投资组合。其次，我们使用强大的机器学习时间序列解决方案——卷积变换器——提取其时间序列信号。最后，我们利用这些信号形成最优交易策略，在约束条件下最大化风险调整后收益。我们对美国股票日度数据的全面实证研究显示，套利者因执行一价定律而获得高额补偿。我们的套利策略获得了可观的样本外平均收益和夏普比率，并优于所有基准方法。本文被Agostino Capponi（金融领域）接收。资助：作者感谢MSCI提供的慷慨研究支持。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Deep Learning Statistical Arbitrage

abstract: We uncover a significant friction in small business lending: perception of risk by Small Business Administration (SBA) employees. Using novel data on SBA employees transferring across offices, we find that more current defaults on SBA loans in their previous location reduce SBA loans and job creation in their current location. The effect is independent of local economic conditions and the informational content of the nonlocal defaults, suggesting that SBA employees update their risk assessment irrationally. Our results are the first to document that regulators’ misperception of economic conditions affects the ability of small businesses to obtain access to finance. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03040 .
abstract_zh: 我们揭示了小企业贷款中一个显著的摩擦：小企业管理局（SBA）员工的风险感知。利用关于SBA员工跨办公室调动的新颖数据，我们发现，其先前所在地SBA贷款当前违约率越高，其当前所在地的SBA贷款和就业创造就越少。该效应独立于当地经济状况以及非本地违约所包含的信息内容，这表明SBA员工非理性地更新其风险评估。我们的结果首次记录到，监管者对经济状况的误判会影响小企业获得融资的能力。本文由Camelia Kuhnen（金融学）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.03040获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Regulatory Risk Perception and Small Business Lending
title_zh: 监管风险感知与小企业贷款
